subjects.description: A single vehicle driving in the wrong direction — against the flow of traffic — entering the intersection through an exit lane
subjects.appearance_details: Standard passenger vehicle viewed from overhead, rooftop visible, traveling in the opposite direction to lane arrow markings beneath it
subjects.relationship: Primary subject — the wrong-way vehicle creating a hazardous conflict
subjects.location: Enters from an approach lane, traveling in the reverse of the indicated direction
subjects.relative_size: Single vehicle, similar scale to other vehicles visible from overhead
subjects.orientation: Facing opposite to the lane's indicated direction of travel
subjects.pose: Upright, wheels contacting the road, moving forward at moderate speed
subjects.action: Enters the intersection traveling against the correct traffic direction at moderate speed, moving into oncoming lanes. Traverses the intersection box without stopping or yielding. Continues out of frame on the wrong side of the road while other traffic reacts around it.
subjects.state_changes: Enters frame in the wrong direction, travels through the intersection at steady speed, and exits — no deceleration or correction

subjects.description: Oncoming vehicles traveling in the correct direction who encounter the wrong-way vehicle
subjects.appearance_details: Multiple vehicles in correct travel lanes, viewed from above
subjects.relationship: Reacting traffic — vehicles responding to the hazard in their path
subjects.location: Correct travel lanes approaching and within the intersection
subjects.orientation: Facing along the correct direction of travel, toward the oncoming wrong-way vehicle
subjects.pose: Upright, wheels contacting the road; transitions to braking posture with small lateral steering adjustments
subjects.action: Approach the intersection normally. React to the wrong-way vehicle with sudden braking and small evasive steering adjustments. Some come to a complete stop; others maneuver laterally to create clearance. No contact occurs. After the wrong-way vehicle clears, traffic cautiously resumes.
subjects.state_changes: Transitions from normal travel to emergency braking and evasive maneuvers, then cautious resumption

Use the provided image as the exact first frame.
